rows.q: What does the Business plan cost per month?
rows.reply: Northwind Cloud offers three plans: Starter at $29 per month, Pro at $99 per month and Business at $299 per month. [billing#1]

rows.q: Is there a discount if I pay yearly?
rows.reply: If a payment fails, we retry the card three times over seven days before pausing the account. [billing#5] Annual billing gives a 20% discount on any plan. [billing#2]

rows.q: Where can I download my invoices?
rows.reply: Invoices are issued on the 1st of each month and can be downloaded from Settings > Billing. [billing#3]

rows.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
rows.reply: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express and bank transfer for annual Business plans. [billing#4]

rows.q: What happens if my card payment fails?
rows.reply: If a payment fails, we retry the card three times over seven days before pausing the account. [billing#5]

rows.q: Can I get my money back on a monthly plan?
rows.reply: The Business plan includes a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA. [sla#1]

rows.q: How long does a refund take to arrive?
rows.reply: I've passed this to our support team (ticket T-1001). Reason: no confident answer in the knowledge base. We'll reply by email.

rows.q: Are overage charges refundable?
rows.reply: Usage-based overage charges are not refundable. [refunds#5]

rows.q: How do I turn on 2FA?
rows.reply: Two-factor authentication can be enabled in Settings > Security using any authenticator app. [security#1]

rows.q: I lost my authenticator phone, how do I log in?
rows.reply: I've passed this to our support team (ticket T-1002). Reason: no confident answer in the knowledge base. We'll reply by email.

rows.q: What is the minimum password length?
rows.reply: Northwind Cloud staff will never ask for your password or backup codes. [security#5]

rows.q: What is the API rate limit on the Pro plan?
rows.reply: The Starter plan allows 60 API requests per minute, Pro allows 600 and Business allows 3000. [api#2] When the rate limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. [api#3]

rows.q: What error do I get when I hit the rate limit?
rows.reply: When the rate limit is exceeded the API returns HTTP 429 with a Retry-After header. [api#3] The Starter plan allows 60 API requests per minute, Pro allows 600 and Business allows 3000. [api#2]

rows.q: How many times are webhooks retried?
rows.reply: Webhooks are retried up to 5 times with exponential backoff. [api#4]

rows.q: Do you have an uptime SLA?
rows.reply: The Business plan includes a 99.9% monthly uptime SLA. [sla#1] If uptime falls below the SLA, customers receive service credits of 10% of the monthly fee per 0.1% below target. [sla#2]

rows.q: What are your support hours?
rows.reply: Support hours are Monday to Friday, 9am to 6pm Singapore time, for Starter and Pro. [sla#3]

rows.q: Where can I see if the service is down?
rows.reply: If uptime falls below the SLA, customers receive service credits of 10% of the monthly fee per 0.1% below target. [sla#2] The current system status is published at status.northwind.example. [sla#5]

rows.q: Where is my data stored?
rows.reply: Customer data is stored in Singapore and Frankfurt data centers. [data#1] You can export all your data as CSV or JSON from Settings > Data at any time. [data#3]

rows.q: Is my data encrypted?
rows.reply: Data is encrypted at rest with AES-256 and in transit with TLS 1.2 or higher. [data#2]

rows.q: How can I export my data?
rows.reply: You can export all your data as CSV or JSON from Settings > Data at any time. [data#3]

rows.q: What happens to my data after I close the account?
rows.reply: After an account is closed, data is permanently deleted after 30 days. [data#4]

rows.q: Do I need a credit card for the free trial?
rows.reply: New workspaces include a 14-day free trial of the Pro plan with no credit card required. [onboarding#1]

rows.q: How many teammates can I invite on Starter?
rows.reply: You can invite team members from Settings > Team; Starter supports up to 3 members, Pro up to 20 and Business is unlimited. [onboarding#2]

rows.q: Can I connect HubSpot?
rows.reply: Integrations with Slack, Google Sheets and HubSpot can be connected from the Integrations page. [onboarding#3]

rows.q: How long does express shipping take?
rows.reply: Standard shipping takes 3 to 7 business days; express shipping takes 1 to 3 business days. [orders#2]

rows.q: My sensor kit arrived damaged, what can I do?
rows.reply: Damaged kits can be replaced free of charge within 30 days of delivery. [orders#4] Northwind sensor kits ship within 2 business days from our Singapore warehouse. [orders#1]
